run_manipulation_viewer: run the dm_control manipulation viewer to interactively visualize a selected robot environment
run_prompt_environment_name: run prompt_environment_name to interactively select a valid environment name from a list of options
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to launch a manipulation environment viewer with an optional flag
review_prompt_environment_name: review prompt_environment_name which loops until the user inputs a valid environment name from values
review_main: review the main function that loads a manipulation environment and launches the viewer
